clues.text: This city sits in a broad valley in the centre of its land, in the Himalaya lands of Asia. Old temples and palaces fill its streets.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player in a valley in the Himalaya lands, in the centre of one land.

source.quote: situated in the central part of the country within the Kathmandu Valley.

clues.text: Most rain here rides in on the summer monsoon winds, from June to September. Warm days give way to cool nights, and winter cold can touch freezing.
clues.narrowing: Rules out dry lands and steady tropics; keeps a monsoon valley with cool nights.

source.quote: Rainfall is mostly monsoon-based (about 65% of the total concentrated during the monsoon months of June to September)

clues.text: A Licchavi king merged two old towns to found this city. It later served for ages as the royal capital of the kingdom.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to old royal capitals founded by merging two towns.

source.quote: Gunakamadeva merged Koligram and Dakshin Koligram, founding the city of Kathmandu.

clues.text: Think of this city as the front door to the Himalayas. Trips to the high peaks start from its busy streets, and guests fill its lanes.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: the gateway city for the Himalaya peaks.

source.quote: Tourism plays a vital role in the economy, with the city serving as a gateway to the Nepal Himalayas.

clues.text: This city is the main seat of government for Nepal. The nation's rule, money, work, and culture all centre here.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Nepal's main seat of government is this city.

source.quote: Kathmandu is the main governmental, financial, industrial, and cultural centre of Nepal.

reveal.blurb: People have lived in this valley since old, old times, and its kings ruled from this city. A Licchavi king founded it by joining two towns, and it grew as a royal capital. Today guests from all over the world pass through it on their way to the great peaks. Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.
